Container.Name: rackboard
Container.Overview: Raccboard: a self-hosted Kanban board with lists, checklists (sublists), sharing with family, calendar and list views, Google Calendar sync, email, themes and an Android app. Open the WebUI and create the first (admin) account.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface and API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and uploaded files. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data folder (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data folder (Unraid: 100 = users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone, used for calendar events.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Public address, e.g. https://kanban.example.com. Used for links in emails, the calendar feed, OIDC and Google sign-in.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to true when behind a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik).

Config.Name: ALLOW_SIGNUP
Config.Description: Let anyone create an account from the sign-in page.

Config.Name: OIDC_ISSUER
Config.Description: Single sign-on issuer URL (Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak, Google…). Leave empty to use local accounts only.

Config.Name: OIDC_NAME
Config.Description: Label for the sign-in button, e.g. Authentik.

Config.Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Google Calendar sync: OAuth client ID (needs PUBLIC_URL with https).

Config.Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Google Calendar sync: OAuth client secret.
